checks.name: GA
checks.title: Part present
checks.question: Is the part the drawing places here physically installed?
checks.doc: Every part present in its place: slot occupancy vs backplate model + label evidence.

checks.name: ORDER
checks.title: Rail order
checks.question: Reading left to right along the rail, is every device in the slot the drawing gives it?
checks.doc: Right place / right order: read labels slot-by-slot along each rail, align with drawing sequence.

checks.name: LABEL
checks.title: Device label
checks.question: Does the label at this device read exactly the tag printed on the drawing?
checks.doc: Every device label present, readable and matching the drawing (closed-vocabulary OCR + voting).

checks.name: FERRULE
checks.title: Ferrule text
checks.question: Is there a sleeve on this wire, and does it read the wire-list string for this terminal?
checks.doc: Read each sleeve; decode against the wire list (closed vocabulary), not free text.

checks.name: COLOUR
checks.title: Wire colour
checks.question: After white-balancing on the white labels, is the wire the colour the wire list specifies?
checks.doc: Wire colour after white-balancing on known-white references (labels/ferrules).
